protocol: MCP; the tier is fixed by the binary launched (ADR-0034) or the endpoint reached (ADR-0050: POST /mcp — the client daemon's loopback listener keyless, the org gate's keyed surface with admin scope)

plugin.instructions: doublegate, in-harness tier: gated memory that works with no gate running. `doublegate.remember` files a claim and returns a handle — `local:` when no gate was reachable, `sha256:` once a gate stamped it — never a promise of admission; nothing you remember is readable to anyone until a reviewer that did not write it promotes it. `doublegate.recall` returns admitted beliefs plus this session's own unreviewed writes, marked `ratified: false`. Do not send `writer_identity` or `deployment_id`: identity is derived from the connection and a request carrying it is refused. There is no promote, sign, delete or trust-class tool: the thing being gated does not operate the gate. Machine-readable API: https://doublegate-io.github.io/llms.txt, then /api/.

tools.name: doublegate.remember
tools.description: Submit content for admission. Returns an artifact id and its state; content is NOT retrievable until ratified.

content_type.description: a class from the artifact taxonomy; an unregistered value is accepted and quarantined under the strictest policy (FR-18)

trust_class.description: T-0..T-5 — a PROPOSAL; the scanner may reclassify (ADR-0021)

derives_from.description: zero or more parent artifact ids; always a list (ADR-0016)

artifact_id.description: sha256:<64 hex> — always prefixed on the wire (§4)

sub_level.description: L1 = scanned clean and waiting on the gate; L1b = a scanner finding, a human clears it (ADR-0053 d1: the scan ran before this answered)

tools.name: doublegate.recall
tools.description: Search ratified beliefs and recorded evidence. Returns provenance with every result.

spaces.description: spaces to search; omitted means the caller's default space only — never all spaces (ADR-0023)

include_provisional.description: FR-12 content, ranked with a penalty; excluding it is allowed, hiding it silently is not

include_superseded.description: ADR-0035 d5: chain members a later head replaced are hidden by default; true returns them, each marked provenance.superseded

audience.description: ADR-0052 d2: the reader's preference, an argument never an identity — each hit's fused score is multiplied by its rank for this audience (1.0 when none) and hides for it apply; omitted = today's answer, byte for byte

include_hidden.description: ADR-0052 d4: rows hidden for this audience (or for all) are dropped before fusion; true returns them, each marked provenance.hidden

include_own_pending.description: ADR-0053 d2 (FR-13): your own scanned, unflagged claims still awaiting review are appended after the ranked hits, each `ratified: false` and `provenance.unreviewed: true` — they may be rejected later and vanish; nobody else's pending claims are ever returned

tools.name: doublegate.status
tools.description: One artifact's position in the register and the reason for it.

artifact_id.description: sha256:<64 hex> — always prefixed on the wire (§4)

tools.name: doublegate.pending
tools.description: What is waiting for review, as metadata only — ids, types, states, ages, finding counts. Never content.

client.instructions: doublegate, client-gate tier: the gate on this host. `doublegate.remember` scans the content before it answers and returns an artifact id and a state (`L1_SCANNED`, or `L1B_FLAGGED` with a findings count and no finding text); content is NOT retrievable to others until ratified — a reviewer that did not write it must sign. `doublegate.recall` searches the admitted store plus YOUR OWN scanned claims still awaiting review, each marked `ratified: false` — treat those as tentative, they may be rejected and vanish; never anyone else's quarantine. Provisional hits are marked, superseded ones hidden unless `include_superseded`. `doublegate.why` is the signed audit trail of one artifact; `doublegate.tip` the served head of its supersession chain; `doublegate.pending` what waits, as metadata only. Do not send `writer_identity` or `deployment_id`: identity is derived from the connection and a request carrying it is refused. There is no promote, sign, delete or trust-class tool. Machine-readable API: https://doublegate-io.github.io/llms.txt, then /api/.

tools.name: doublegate.rank
tools.description: Weight a promoted claim for one audience (ADR-0052). recall(audience=…) multiplies the hit by it; 1.0 when none — less likely, never absent. Any non-writer identity may rank, human or agent; the claim's own writer is refused (I2). The audience is a string you choose.

tools.name: doublegate.hide
tools.description: Stop serving a promoted claim to one audience, or to all — reversibly (ADR-0052 d4). The claim stays active and why-able; include_hidden returns it. lift=true reverses. A hide for `all` by a non-operator is journaled `lowered` and listed by doctor. Ending a claim is the operator's demote.

tools.name: doublegate.ban
tools.description: Refuse a writer's, or a source prefix's, next remember at the door (ADR-0052 d6) — operator only; an agent calling this is refused. Touches nothing already admitted.
